mapper.select: select c.id, d.dname, d.deptno, c.title, c.start_date, c.end_date from dcalendar c join dept d on c.deptno = d.deptno where c.deptno = #{deptno} order by c.start_date

select c.id, d.dname, d.deptno, c.title, c.start_date, c.end_date from dcalendar c join dept d on c.deptno = d.deptno where c.deptno = #{deptno} and c.start_date like CONCAT(CURDATE(), '%') order by c.start_date
mapper.insert: insert into dcalendar ( id, deptno, title, start_date, end_date ) values ( "C0015", #{deptno}, #{title}, #{start_date}, #{end_date} )
